I am recruiting for a fully funded PhD to join my ERC Starting Grant project, FUTUREFAUNA, at the University of Glasgow School of Computing Science, starting 1st June 2027.

The PhD student will focus on designing and building bespoke interfaces centred around animals’ needs, with a particular emphasis on zoos. The aim is to develop technology for and with animals, and the student will gain hands-on experience designing and building interactive computer systems. I am looking for candidates with experience in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), including designing and running user studies and research methods.

Funding: The studentship is fully funded for fees and a stipend at UKRI rates. Funding is open to UK/EU citizens.

Application:

Deadline: 4th January 2027.

I’m happy to chat before you apply, so please get in touch with any questions at
. Please feel free to share this with students or colleagues who may be interested.
